purpose: Platform capability evidence for proposed Apex design; not accepted installation state

claims.statement: CLAUDE.md ancestors concatenate at launch; descendant files load on file interaction. Importing a document loads its contents; prose asking to read it is discretionary.
claims.design_implication: Keep a concise native entrypoint; distinguish imported context from linked references.

claims.statement: Native AGENTS.md starts in v2.1.277; default uses it only without ancestor/current CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md. Plugin option IDs changed at v2.1.285; pre-2.1.281 availability had exceptions. Native AGENTS loading does not fire InstructionsLoaded.
claims.design_implication: A root AGENTS file does not prove Claude loaded it; retain an explicit import adapter until validated.

claims.statement: Skills use .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md or ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Descriptions support model selection; slash invocation is explicit. disable-model-invocation suppresses autonomous invocation; user-invocable:false only hides the user command.
claims.version_condition: Current docs; probe installed frontmatter support
claims.design_implication: Select coherent procedures, not every reference; test invocation and source reading separately.

claims.statement: Invoked skill content persists, but allowed-tools grants expire at the next user message. Compaction reattaches up to 5,000 tokens per skill within 25,000 total, newest first; older skills can disappear.
claims.design_implication: Never treat a past invocation or tool allowance as durable task state; reload consequential constraints on recovery.

claims.statement: Hook settings have hooks[event] arrays with matchers and handlers. Prompt injection uses UserPromptSubmit additionalContext; SessionStart supports startup, resume, compact, clear, fork. PreToolUse uses tool_name/tool_input and permissionDecision in hookSpecificOutput.
claims.version_condition: Current docs; validate exact event availability
claims.design_implication: Use distinct event encoders; prompt hooks reach chat-only tasks without requiring file tools.

claims.statement: Command exit 2 blocks only applicable events. Other failures usually continue; onFailure:block for command/http requires v2.1.295+. Match Bash and PowerShell. @ file attachments may bypass tool hooks.
claims.design_implication: A read trace based only on tools is incomplete; cover failures and separate native permissions from hook checks.

claims.statement: Custom agents use .claude/agents/*.md or ~/.claude/agents/*.md with required name/description. Explicit tools restrict access. Plugin agent hooks, mcpServers, permissionMode fields are ignored. Regular subagents start separately; forks inherit conversation.
claims.version_condition: Current docs; plugin and normal agents differ
claims.design_implication: Pass scoped evidence and rules explicitly; verifier role should use a read-only native tool allowlist.

claims.statement: Settings priority is managed, --settings, local project, shared project, user; list fields often merge. JSON must parse; headless sessions can skip invalid non-managed configuration and continue. SchemaStore may lag current CLI keys.
claims.design_implication: Read loaded settings and run doctor; shape checks alone cannot prove a configuration applied.

claims.statement: The documented key is permissions.defaultMode. Current auto/bypassPermissions values are ignored in project/local settings; bypass accepted those scopes before v2.1.257. VS Code initiation reads user/managed/--settings values.
claims.design_implication: A repository top-level defaultMode:bypassPermissions is not evidence of effective bypass; preserve as observed text and probe runtime.

claims.statement: Permission rules are enforced by the host; prompt instructions do not change authority. Bare-tool denies remove tools, scoped denies block matches. Permission mode and tool preapproval are separate from tool availability.
claims.design_implication: Do not use skill allowed-tools as a tool restriction or research evidence as execution authorization.

claims.statement: Regular claude -p discovers normal customizations; --bare skips hooks, skills, agents, plugins, MCP, memory and CLAUDE.md auto-discovery, with explicit-load exceptions. Bare mode does not use subscription OAuth login.
claims.version_condition: Current docs; future -p default change mentioned but not assumed
claims.design_implication: Pin invocation mode; a scripted probe must verify discovery before interpreting adherence.

claims.statement: Cloud project threads do not apply repository settings hooks/permissions/env. Single-repository cloud sessions outside project threads can read shared settings. Hosted multi-repository sessions differ; workstation user/local settings do not transfer.
claims.design_implication: Use a separate cloud capability record; never claim local hook coverage in hosted sessions.

claims.statement: Current Agent SDK defaults discover user/project skills. Explicit settingSources can disable that discovery; skills option controls model invocation. Init stream lists only user-invocable skills.
claims.version_condition: Current docs; older SDK advice may differ
claims.design_implication: Record SDK and CLI dependency versions; assert expected skills before running an evaluation.

claims.statement: SDK callbacks are a distinct integration contract from shell-command JSON hooks, despite using the Claude agent loop.
claims.design_implication: Keep SDK a separate adapter profile; no new API harness is necessary for the proposed CLI-first design.

claims.statement: Latest release visible in the opened changelog is 2.1.322 dated 2026-11-10.
claims.design_implication: Use feature-specific minima rather than assuming installed latest.

claims.statement: Antigravity discovers workspace folders and ancestors through repo root, not descendants when files are touched. Shared customization root is .agents/ or ~/.gemini/config/. Legacy folder aliases remain recognized.
claims.version_condition: Current opened docs; search excerpt conflicts
claims.design_implication: Put scoped rules in discovered root and use globs or explicit routing; do not copy Claude descendant discovery assumptions.

claims.statement: AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md are always-on Markdown. Modular rules require trigger: always_on, model_decision, glob, or manual; invalid spellings can silently discard rules. CLI lacks manual rule @ mentions.
claims.design_implication: Validate frontmatter; manual rules require CLI fallback through a skill or explicit read.

claims.statement: @[label](path) inlines content; @filename is a reference. Per-rule limit is 24,000 bytes after expansion; aggregate always-on/global budget is 20,000 tokens with pointer demotion.
claims.version_condition: Current docs, not a recommended target size
claims.design_implication: Avoid inlining the full registry or reference tree; content availability does not prove delivery.

claims.statement: Current skills are folders with SKILL.md. Workspace .agents/skills and global ~/.gemini/config/skills are shared; CLI additionally reads ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills and ~/.gemini/skills. IDE supports legacy ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills.
claims.version_condition: Current docs; older CLI page conflicts
claims.design_implication: Use portable bundle shape and shared current roots, with explicit per-surface projections.

claims.statement: Skill names/descriptions are shown each turn; relevant bodies are read on demand. Slash commands are available; CLI /skills reload or a new conversation refreshes newly added commands.
claims.design_implication: Do not infer semantic adherence from discovery or slash-command existence.

claims.statement: Hooks use .agents/hooks.json or ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json, not CLI settings.json. Top-level keys name hooks. Events: SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreInvocation, PostInvocation, Stop. Payloads use camelCase; timeout is seconds.
claims.version_condition: Current shared hooks page; local support unverified
claims.design_implication: Translate payloads; do not deploy Claude/Gemini hook JSON unchanged.

claims.statement: PreToolUse reads toolCall.name/args and returns decision/reason. PreInvocation can inject ephemeralMessage through injectSteps. PostToolUse returns {}; PostInvocation can force_continue or terminate. No dedicated compaction event appears in this reference.
claims.version_condition: Current documented event set; absence is documentation scope only
claims.design_implication: Use idempotent pre-invocation recovery plus checkpoint file; cap continuation retries.

claims.statement: Custom agents are documented for App/CLI: .agents/agents/<name>.md or <name>/agent.md, plus global ~/.gemini/config/agents. Fields include name, description, tools, mainAgent, subagent, model, skills. Misspelled tool names may hang.
claims.version_condition: Standalone IDE parity not established by this page
claims.design_implication: Create separate native role files and validate exact tool names; do not deploy an IDE agent claim without a probe.

claims.statement: Normal subagents start without parent conversation history. Workspace modes may inherit/share or create worktrees.
claims.design_implication: Pass task envelope and explicit no-branch boundary; do not enable branch workspaces in a main-only run.

claims.statement: CLI permission lists live in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json, with deny > ask > allow. Workspace files are ordinarily allowed. Windows normalization and command matching differ from naive string matching.
claims.design_implication: Separate customization distribution from operator permission policy; test Windows paths and command coverage.

claims.statement: Headless agy -p has JSON/streaming output. Unobtainable approval can soft-deny a tool while exiting 0. Unknown pinned model exits with error rather than silently selecting another.
claims.design_implication: Require actual artifact and denial checks, not exit zero alone; pin surface and model.

claims.statement: Gemini migration changes extension packaging and workspace skill/MCP locations; Antigravity MCP uses standalone mcp_config.json with serverUrl for remote endpoints. Its broad identical-rules claim conflicts with current discovery details.
claims.design_implication: Migrate deliberately by component with preimages; keep Gemini as a distinct compatibility profile.

claims.statement: Current migration guidance says workflows are deprecated but remain working for now. /migrate-workflows is App-only from 2.12.0; CLI/IDE use manual migration.
claims.version_condition: Earlier indexed cutoff claim not established by current canonical page
claims.design_implication: Propose workflow-to-skill mapping without asserting an outage or executing migration.

claims.statement: Opened changelog lists App 2.31.0 dated 2026-11-09 and CLI 1.5.5 dated 2026-11-10; rollouts are gradual.
claims.design_implication: A historical App 2.8.1 says nothing about present CLI version.

claims.statement: Antigravity SDK is a Python runtime distinct from the managed cloud API. It has decorator-based lifecycle hooks and session persistence.
claims.design_implication: Do not claim hooks.json gives SDK/API parity; CLI-first plan needs no SDK adoption.

claims.statement: Gemini CLI uses global, workspace and just-in-time GEMINI.md ancestry; /memory show exposes concatenated context and /memory reload refreshes it.
claims.design_implication: Do not confuse Gemini JIT behavior with current Antigravity root-only discovery.

claims.statement: Gemini skills discover from built-in, extension, user, workspace tiers. .agents/skills aliases .gemini/skills. activate_skill requests consent and exposes bundled resources after approval.
claims.version_condition: Current docs; effective consent depends on host policy
claims.design_implication: Shared package shape is plausible; activation authority and consent remain platform-specific.

claims.statement: Gemini hooks are in settings.json under hooks[event]; command timeout is milliseconds. BeforeAgent adds per-turn context; AfterAgent can reject final responses and retry. PreCompress is available. Exit codes other than 0/2 continue with warnings.
claims.design_implication: Use dedicated encoding, preserve retry guard, and do not port Antigravity seconds as milliseconds.

claims.statement: Gemini custom agents use .gemini/agents/*.md or ~/.gemini/agents/*.md. Markdown frontmatter supports tools/model/kind; omitted tools inherit parent access. Current docs say subagents are enabled by default.
claims.version_condition: Page reports update 2026-06-08; version probe required
claims.design_implication: Explicit read-only tool lists for verifiers; no assumption from older experimental flag naming.

claims.statement: Settings files include system-defaults, user, project and system override scopes; environment/CLI have additional precedence. hooksConfig.enabled and skills.enabled can disable mechanisms. Official repository publishes settings.schema.json.
claims.design_implication: Record effective settings, trust and enabled state alongside file hashes.

claims.statement: Release notes include 0.64.0 atomic state persistence and recovery, 0.63.0 bounded tool output, and 0.59.0 fail-closed workspace trust. Latest visible announcement is not proof of installed or latest binary.
claims.design_implication: Revalidate old resumption/trust assumptions on the actual version.

claims.statement: Codex builds guidance at launch: global override or AGENTS.md, then one override/AGENTS/fallback file per directory from root to cwd. The default combined limit is 32 KiB; it does not discover deeper directories in that launch chain.
claims.design_implication: Make launch location and instruction hashes part of the fingerprint; explicitly route newly entered scopes.

claims.statement: Skills discover from .agents/skills at cwd/ancestors through repository root, user ~/.agents/skills, /etc/codex/skills, and bundled sources. Initial metadata uses 2% of context by default (8,000 characters if unknown); descriptions can shorten and skills disappear from that list. Explicit and implicit invocation coexist.
claims.design_implication: Keep descriptions discriminative; confirm catalog inclusion and body reading independently.

claims.statement: UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart deliver context. PreModelRequest/PostModelRequest are diagnostic only. Prompt/agent handlers parse but are skipped.
claims.design_implication: Route chat before the turn; never design a Codex model-event enforcement gate.

claims.statement: Hooks combine across layers; nonmanaged definitions require exact-hash trust. Local Bash, apply_patch, MCP and function paths are covered; hosted/special paths can bypass them. write_stdin does not repeat PreToolUse.
claims.design_implication: Model the observed tool/event coverage; do not claim an execution security boundary.

claims.statement: PreToolUse ask, legacy approve and continue:false parse but are unsupported; failure can continue execution. Deny and bounded additionalContext have documented envelopes.
claims.design_implication: Require semantic allowlisting in addition to JSON Schema validation.

claims.statement: Work Cloud does not load local hook scripts. Eligible managed cloud orchestration uses Global MCP hooks; errors can fail open.
claims.design_implication: Treat cloud integration as a separate optional deployment, not a file-copy adapter.

claims.statement: Config precedence is CLI, trusted project, selected profile, user, cloud defaults, system, built-in. Since 0.134.0, profiles use ~/.codex/<name>.config.toml; old profiles tables and the profile selector are unsupported.
claims.design_implication: Generate current profile files only after version confirmation; preserve old source for review.

claims.statement: approval_policy="untrusted" is retired; project trust_level="untrusted" is distinct and disables project configuration. Sandbox and approvals remain separate. Custom permission profiles must not be mixed with sandbox_mode.
claims.design_implication: Do not turn an obsolete key into broader authority; select an explicit operator-approved host policy.

claims.statement: Custom .codex/agents/*.toml files require name, description and developer_instructions. Children inherit parent permissions, provider and MCP; those cannot be overridden by the agent file.
claims.design_implication: Read-only prose is a role instruction, not isolation. Launch the parent in the needed sandbox.

claims.statement: codex exec is the noninteractive surface; --full-auto is retired. A required enabled MCP server failing initialization makes exec fail.
claims.design_implication: Record flags and expected dependencies; score artifacts and events, not only process success.

claims.statement: The TypeScript SDK starts and resumes local threads. Removed codex mcp-server integrations should migrate to app server.
claims.design_implication: An SDK harness is optional integration work, not a prerequisite for native CLI activation.

claims.statement: Starlark prefix rules govern commands outside the sandbox; the strictest match wins. Local .rules files are not automatically Work Cloud policy.
claims.design_implication: Keep execpolicy separate from domain rules and conversational routing.

claims.statement: The opened changelog lists Codex CLI 0.167.2 on 2026-11-11.
claims.design_implication: Treat release availability separately from the operator installation.
